comment: Minimum PASSING test count per workspace, checked by scripts/check-test-floor.mjs. This is a RATCHET against a suite that silently shrinks, not a coverage target. It exists because `--experimental-test-isolation=none` (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) swallows a module-level throw once any test in that file has registered: the run goes green, exits 0, and simply reports fewer tests. Measured: 2174 instead of 2175, with `# fail 0`. A count floor is the only thing that turns that back into a red. Raise these when tests are added; lowering one is a deliberate act that should be explained in the commit. LOWERED 2026-08-19: backthread 729 -> 714 (712 after the removal, +3 for the retired-name tests: two behavioural, one over its source). The pre-edit PreToolUse hook was removed (founder decision, see cli/hooks/hooks.json's $comment_no_pretooluse_edit), retiring editNudge.test.ts's 15 tests and 2 `edit-context` dispatch tests in bin.test.ts. The suite shrank because the feature did, not because tests were dropped: the case that pinned the hook's existence was INVERTED into a guard in plugin.test.ts rather than deleted. RAISED 2026-08-21: backthread 715 -> 817 (+102), measured, for the failure-copy work. Nothing was removed: src/failureCopy.test.ts is new (the renderer, the endpoint registry, the guards, and a conformance battery of 4 properties x 9 rendered endpoints generated FROM the registry, so the count moves with the endpoint list), plus flag-dispatch cases in bin.test.ts and behavioural cases added to capture/infer/inflow/lesson/localDecisions/onboardingState tests. Several EXISTING tests changed their expected string rather than being dropped, because the rendered failure changed, which is the point of the change. The number rose across four rounds as three independent reviews each found real defects: two registry entries claiming a failure was never shown on surfaces that print it, the renderer treating `error` as always a machine slug when the worker also writes prose there, a bug-report tail appended to deliberate refusals, seven ways past the endpoint guard, and five surviving mutants. A fourth review then found a prototype-chain leak putting `function toString() { [native code] }` in front of a user, two copy entries advising the reader to ask owners of a repo that by definition has none, an instruction the MCP surface could not follow, six more ways past the endpoint guard, and nine survivors. Every one of those is now a named test.  RAISED 2026-08-19: @backthread/extractor 2175 -> 2201 for packages/extractor/src/safety.test.ts — the source-tree budget and its symlink-escape guard, which previously had no test that failed when it broke.
